purpose: Keep the One Ring as the persistent strategic and emotional axis of the game while routes, exploration and side activities remain subordinate to the fixed film chronology.
invariants: The Ring quest is never replaced by exploration, side activities, combat loops or parallel routes.
Part I canonical transfer is Bilbo to Frodo; optional systems may not transfer ownership.
GandalfParallel never carries the Ring; the Ring remains with Frodo off-route.
The Fellowship split preserves Frodo as Ring-bearer and Sam as the companion who continues with him.
Ring use and temptation may be represented only at authored story-safe beats and may not create an alternate film outcome.
Ring state derives from authoritative route/chapter/story state instead of a competing story manager.

part2: Frodo/Sam/Gollum remains the direct Ring-destruction route
Rohan/Ent/Gandalf routes serve the war around the Ring quest
part3: Mordor crossing and Mount Doom remain the terminal Ring objective
Other routes protect time, armies and access without changing the Ring outcome
